newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ASIAN DEV BANK TO PROVIDE $1.2 BLN TO THAILAND.
newsitem.headline: ASIAN DEV BANK TO PROVIDE $1.2 BLN TO THAILAND.

text.p: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) said on Tuesday it plans to provide about $1.2 billion over the next three years to support cash-strapped Thailand.
The amount is part of a $16 billion loan package agreed on by the international community in Tokyo on Monday.
ADB President Mitsuo Sato said in a statement the Thai economy was fundamentally strong.

Effective implementation of the economic stabilization programme being undertaken with the assistance of the International Monetary Fund would help Thailand overcome its current difficulties, he said.
Sato said while it was necessary to reform the financial sector, it was also important to address the social costs of adjustment to ensure the reform effort is sustained.

"It is also important for Thailand to restructure its industrial sector to maintain international competitiveness. The ADB, together with other international agencies, is ready to help the government in these areas," he said.
